description: Create a post, page or item of another post type. post_title is required. post_content accepts HTML, blocks or Markdown. The status is draft unless post_status says otherwise, and the type is post unless post_type says otherwise. meta_input sets custom fields.

meta_input.description: Custom fields as key/value pairs. Keys starting with an underscore (WordPress internals) are refused, except the Yoast SEO title, description and focus keyphrase.

name: wp_create_post
title: Create post
